title: Hardening: protocol tests, restore drill and contract guardrails
summary: Closed the verification gaps left by live-only checks: every Minecraft control channel and the RCON/ping protocols are tested offline, Pi-hole payload parsing is replayed from recorded shapes, Docker and agent-runtime edge cases are covered, and a backup is restored into a fresh data directory and served by the API. Contract drift and static security checks are enforced by the test suite.
changes: 117 pytest tests (was 82): +10 Minecraft protocol/control, +6 Pi-hole parsing, +11 integration edges, +8 contract/security
Supervised pty stop, SIGINT fallback and the no-safe-channel refusal are asserted without touching the live server
Backup restore drill serves the restored milestone, token and screenshot bytes
OpenAPI snapshot equality, no-shell-execution checks and Docker helper allow-list tests added
SwiftUI call-site checker wired into the iOS validation script; optional-default compile hazards fixed
